origin.rustic.amphibian.name: Amphibian
origin.rustic.amphibian.description: Creature of the deep waters. [In Water] Swims freely without fluid resistance and rapidly regenerates health. [On Land] Without water or rain, dries out and becomes slowed.
origin.rustic.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origin.rustic.arachnid.description: Silent predator of the caves. [Walking Toward Wall] Climbs vertically on rock walls. [Passive] Reduces fall damage by 60%.
origin.rustic.archivist.name: Archivist
origin.rustic.archivist.description: Learned scholar. [Right-Click with Blank Book] Sacrifices 5 experience levels to inscribe the book with random enchantments.
origin.rustic.automaton.name: Automaton
origin.rustic.automaton.description: Iron and brass construct. [Passive] +4 natural armor. Cannot heal from food. [Right-Click with Iron Ingot] Restores 3 hearts. [Right-Click with Iron Nugget] Restores 0.75 hearts. [Right-Click with Copper Ingot] Feeds for saturation.
origin.rustic.blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
origin.rustic.blacksmith.description: Master of the anvil. [Passive] 50% resistance to fire and lava. [At Anvil] Repairing weapons and tools costs much less experience and lasts longer. [Exclusive] Only Blacksmiths can use the Smithing Anvil.
origin.rustic.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
origin.rustic.dragonborn.description: Offspring with dragon blood. [Passive] Complete immunity to fire and lava. [Key G] Activates or deactivates dragon wings for elytra flight when not wearing heavy armor.
origin.rustic.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.rustic.dwarf.description: Master of the depths. [Below Y=60] Automatically gains continuous Resistance II and Night Vision in darkness. [With Pickaxe in Hand] Gains continuous Haste I while mining.
origin.rustic.enderian.name: Enderian
origin.rustic.enderian.description: Born of the Void. [Key G] Instant teleportation to where you look (no pearl consumed). [Passive] Increased attack range (+1.5 blocks). [Weakness] Water and rain cause burning damage.
origin.rustic.explorer.name: Explorer
origin.rustic.explorer.description: Trail wanderer. [Sprint Step] Automatically steps over 1-block-high blocks. Running does not consume saturation. [Near Campfire] Heals rapidly.
origin.rustic.farmer.name: Farmer
origin.rustic.farmer.description: Worker of the soil. [Near Crops] Moves faster. Harvesting wheat yields double drops.
origin.rustic.farrier.name: Farrier
origin.rustic.farrier.description: Horse master. [Riding a Horse] Mount automatically gains Speed I (+25%) and Jump Boost I. [Key G] Royal Care: grants the ridden or nearby horse Regeneration II (5s) and Speed II (8s).
origin.rustic.fisherman.name: Fisherman
origin.rustic.fisherman.description: Man of the ponds. [Fishing with Rod] Massively increased luck for capturing sunken treasures, relics and enchanted tools.
origin.rustic.frostborn.name: Frostborn
origin.rustic.frostborn.description: Creature of the glaciers. [In Ice Biomes] Increased strength and regeneration. [In Heat/Fire] Takes increased damage from fire and lava.
origin.rustic.human.name: Human
origin.rustic.human.description: Common person with no elemental ties. [Passive] No magical weaknesses and no supernatural advantages, with all base attributes unchanged.
origin.rustic.lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
origin.rustic.lumberjack.description: Brawny axeman. [Cutting with Axe] Felling a trunk can topple the entire tree in a single strike. Grants bonus planks when chopping.
origin.rustic.mason.name: Mason
origin.rustic.mason.description: Fortress builder. [On Stone] Increased jump and safety on scaffolding. [Extended Reach] Places blocks from a distance (+1.5 blocks). Breaks stone much faster.
origin.rustic.miner.name: Miner
origin.rustic.miner.description: Borer of the depths. [When Mining Ores] Double speed breaking stone and double drops from ores. Mining costs 50% less hunger/exhaustion.
origin.rustic.nitwit.name: Nitwit
origin.rustic.nitwit.description: Common wanderer with no trade. [Passive] No special abilities or advantages of any kind.
origin.rustic.phantom.name: Phantom
origin.rustic.phantom.description: Wandering spirit. [Key G] Passes through solid blocks and becomes invisible. [Passive] Gentle levitation immune to fall damage. [Disadvantage] Frail body with only 7 maximum hearts.
origin.rustic.salahor.name: Laborer
origin.rustic.salahor.description: Mighty giant. [Passive] +10 hearts (30 total), +4 melee damage, +1.5 block attack reach and complete knockback immunity. [Disadvantage] Movement speed reduced by 20%.
origin.rustic.sylvan.name: Sylvan
origin.rustic.sylvan.description: Soul of the forest. [Under Forest Canopy] Runs at increased speed (+20%) under the canopy of forest or jungle trees.
origin.rustic.undead.name: Undead
origin.rustic.undead.description: Undead risen from the grave. [Right-Click with Rotten Flesh] Feeds and heals health without nausea. [Passive] Immune to poison and magical damage; has only 7 max hearts. [Under Sun] Burns if not wearing a helmet.
origin.rustic.vampire.name: Vampire
origin.rustic.vampire.description: Creature of the night. [Melee Attack] Steals life from enemies with every weapon hit. [Under Sun] Burns violently when exposed to daylight.
power.rustic.amphibian_dry_weakness.name: Land Withering
power.rustic.amphibian_dry_weakness.desc: [Passive] Far from water and without rain, your body dries out, causing slowness and weakness.
power.rustic.amphibian_ignore_water.name: Wave Walking
power.rustic.amphibian_ignore_water.desc: [Passive] You move and swim through water without fluid resistance or slowness.
power.rustic.amphibian_water_regen.name: Spring Healing
power.rustic.amphibian_water_regen.descr: [In Water] Submerging in clean water rapidly regenerates your health.
power.rustic.arachnid_climbing.name: Rock Climbing
power.rustic.arachnid_climbing.descripti: [Walking Toward Wall] Hold the forward key to climb any vertical wall.
power.rustic.arachnid_fall_resist.name: Soft Landing
power.rustic.arachnid_fall_resist.descri: [Passive] Your flexible body absorbs 60% of fall damage.
power.rustic.archivist_enchantments.name: Inscription of Tomes
power.rustic.archivist_enchantments.desc: [Right-Click with Blank Book] Consumes 5 experience levels to turn the book into an enchanted tome.
power.rustic.automaton_armor.name: Iron-Forged Plate
power.rustic.automaton_armor.description: [Passive] Your mechanical body naturally provides +4 armor points.
power.rustic.automaton_copper_feed.name: Copper Fuel
power.rustic.automaton_copper_feed.descr: [Right-Click with Copper Ingot] Feeds the mechanical core, restoring the hunger and saturation bar.
power.rustic.automaton_iron_repair.name: Iron Frame Repair
power.rustic.automaton_iron_repair.descr: [Right-Click with Iron Ingot] Instantly restores 3 hearts (or 0.75 hearts with an iron nugget) even at full saturation.
power.rustic.automaton_no_regen.name: No Blood and Flesh
power.rustic.automaton_no_regen.descript: [Passive] You cannot naturally heal from food; use iron for repairs.
power.rustic.blacksmith_fire_resist.name: Forge Hardening
power.rustic.blacksmith_fire_resist.desc: [Passive] Your furnace-hardened skin reduces all fire and lava damage by 50%.
power.rustic.dragonborn_flight.name: Dragon Wings
power.rustic.dragonborn_flight.descripti: [Key G / Primary] Activates/deactivates dragon wings for elytra flight when not wearing heavy armor.
power.rustic.dragonborn_resistance.name: Dragon Scales
power.rustic.dragonborn_resistance.descr: [Passive] Your tough scales make you completely immune to fire and lava damage.
power.rustic.dwarf_pickaxe_haste.name: Pickaxe Mastery
power.rustic.dwarf_pickaxe_haste.descrip: [With Pickaxe in Hand] Continuously grants the Haste I effect.
power.rustic.dwarf_underground_resistanc: [Below Y=60] The earth's depths automatically grant you continuous Resistance II.
power.rustic.dwarf_underground_vision.de: [Below Y=60] You automatically gain Night Vision in deep caves.
power.rustic.explorer_campfire_rest.name: Campfire Rest
power.rustic.explorer_campfire_rest.desc: [Near Campfire] Resting by a campfire rapidly regenerates your health.
power.rustic.explorer_climbers_step.name: Mountain Sprint Step
power.rustic.explorer_climbers_step.desc: [Passive] You automatically step over full 1-block-high blocks without jumping.
power.rustic.explorer_stamina.name: Endless Trekking
power.rustic.explorer_stamina.descriptio: [Passive] Running long distances does not consume your hunger bar.
power.rustic.farmer_crop_speed.name: Sower's Step
power.rustic.farmer_crop_speed.descripti: [Near Crops] You move faster on cultivated land and fields.
power.rustic.farmer_double_beetroots.des: [Passive] Harvesting ripe beetroot guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farmer_double_carrots.name: Bountiful Carrot Harvest
power.rustic.farmer_double_carrots.descr: [Passive] Harvesting ripe carrots guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farmer_double_cocoa.name: Bountiful Cocoa Harvest
power.rustic.farmer_double_cocoa.descrip: [Passive] Picking ripe cocoa pods guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farmer_double_nether_wart.d: [Passive] Harvesting nether wart from the Nether guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farmer_double_potatoes.name: Bountiful Potato Harvest
power.rustic.farmer_double_potatoes.desc: [Passive] Harvesting ripe potatoes guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farmer_double_wheat.name: Bountiful Wheat Bundle
power.rustic.farmer_double_wheat.descrip: [Passive] Harvesting ripe wheat guarantees double the yield.
power.rustic.farrier_equine_care.name: Royal Care
power.rustic.farrier_equine_care.descrip: [Key G / Primary] Grants the ridden or nearby horse (within 4 blocks) Regeneration II (5s) and Speed II (8s).
power.rustic.farrier_mount_jump.name: Stable Jump
power.rustic.farrier_mount_jump.descript: [Mounted] The horse you ride jumps higher (Jump Boost I).
power.rustic.farrier_mounted_speed.name: Shod Step
power.rustic.farrier_mounted_speed.descr: [Mounted] Horses you ride move 25% faster (Speed I).
power.rustic.fisherman_fishing.name: Rod Bite
power.rustic.fisherman_fishing.descripti: [Fishing] Fish bite the hook much faster.
power.rustic.fisherman_more_treasure.des: [Fishing] Increased chance of pulling up treasures and valuable relics from the depths.
power.rustic.lumber_bonus_wood.name: Wood Bonus
power.rustic.lumber_bonus_wood.descripti: [When Cutting Wood] You obtain an increased amount of planks and logs when chopping.
power.rustic.mason_block_reach.name: Mason's Reach
power.rustic.mason_block_reach.descripti: [Passive] Block placement range extended by +1.5 blocks.
power.rustic.mason_break_speed.name: Fortress Chiseling
power.rustic.mason_break_speed.descripti: [Passive] Increased speed when breaking and chiseling stone blocks.
power.rustic.mason_jump_boost.name: Beam Step
power.rustic.mason_jump_boost.descriptio: [On Stone] You jump higher when leaping off stone blocks.
power.rustic.more_stone_break_speed.name: Stone Crusher
power.rustic.more_stone_break_speed.desc: [Passive] Break stone and underground blocks at double speed.
power.rustic.night_vision.name: Night Vision
power.rustic.night_vision.description: [Passive] Your gaze pierces the darkness without need of a torch.
power.rustic.no_mining_exhaustion.name: Tireless Arm
power.rustic.no_mining_exhaustion.descri: [Passive] Mining and digging activities consume 50% less hunger.
power.rustic.phantom_dodge.name: Shadow Dodge
power.rustic.phantom_dodge.description: [Passive] Chance to completely avoid enemy strikes by becoming shadow.
power.rustic.phantom_less_health.name: Frail Body
power.rustic.phantom_less_health.descrip: [Disadvantage] Your vaporous body has 3 fewer hearts (maximum 7 hearts).
power.rustic.phantom_no_fall_damage.name: Specter's Levitation
power.rustic.phantom_no_fall_damage.desc: [Passive] Complete immunity to any fall damage.
power.rustic.phantom_phasing.name: Wall Phasing
power.rustic.phantom_phasing.description: [Key G / Primary] Pass through walls and solid blocks for a few seconds.
power.rustic.phantom_prevent_targeting_w: [In Phantom Mode] Monsters and beasts cannot see or attack you.
power.rustic.phantom_slow_falling.name: Gentle Descent
power.rustic.phantom_slow_falling.descri: [Falling] You descend gently to the ground like a feather.
power.rustic.salahor_crushing_grip.name: Stone Grip
power.rustic.salahor_crushing_grip.descr: [Passive] Your massive fists deal +4.0 base attack damage.
power.rustic.salahor_health.name: Giant's Vitality
power.rustic.salahor_health.description: [Passive] Your massive body grants +10 hearts (total 30 hearts).
power.rustic.salahor_heavy_steps.name: Heavy Steps
power.rustic.salahor_heavy_steps.descrip: [Disadvantage] Your body's weight reduces your movement speed by 20%.
power.rustic.salahor_reach.name: Oak Arms
power.rustic.salahor_reach.description: [Passive] Your attack and tool reach is extended by +1.5 blocks.
power.rustic.salahor_size.name: Giant Stature
power.rustic.salahor_size.description: [Passive] Your stature is much taller than ordinary people.
power.rustic.salahor_unmoving.name: Immovable as a Mountain
power.rustic.salahor_unmoving.descriptio: [Passive] 100% immunity to knockback; no hit can move you.
power.rustic.sylvan_forest_speed.name: Forest Sprint
power.rustic.sylvan_forest_speed.descrip: [In Forest] Increased movement speed when under the tree canopy.
power.rustic.undead_enhanced_food.name: Ghoul's Feast
power.rustic.undead_enhanced_food.descri: [Right-Click with Rotten Flesh] You eat rotten flesh without gaining hunger/nausea effects.
power.rustic.undead_food_heal.name: Carrion Restoration
power.rustic.undead_food_heal.descriptio: [Right-Click with Rotten Flesh] Consuming rotten flesh directly regenerates your lost health.
power.rustic.undead_harming_immunity.des: [Passive] Harming effects and poisons have no effect on you.
power.rustic.undead_less_health.name: Withered Body
power.rustic.undead_less_health.descript: [Disadvantage] Your death-worn body has 3 fewer hearts (total 7 hearts).
power.rustic.undead_poison_immunity.name: Poison and Hunger Immunity
power.rustic.undead_poison_immunity.desc: [Passive] Complete immunity to poison and hunger effects.
power.rustic.weakness_sun.name: Solar Scorching
power.rustic.weakness_sun.description: [Under Open Sky] Direct sunlight sets you ablaze if you are not wearing a helmet.
power.rustic.weakness_water.name: Water Burn
power.rustic.weakness_water.description: [In Water / Rain] Contact with water or rain deals continuous damage to you.
